info.title: LootLens API
info.description: Route handlers for LootLens. Every success body is `{ data }`, except `/api/health`, which returns `{ status: ok }`. Every error body is `{ error: { code, message } }`. All prices are USD numbers. Listings are labelled `source: demo` or `live`. No store site is scraped. Sign in at /signin in this browser first; Try it out then sends your session cookie automatically.

get.summary: List the user's items with the cheapest current listing for the saved size

post.summary: Add an item. Demo listings are created at 3 to 5 stores.

patch.summary: Update an item. Any subset of the create fields. The merged item must still be valid.
patch.description: Changing sizes drops watches (and their alerts) on sizes that are gone, and regenerates demo stock for the new sizes.

delete.summary: Delete an item with its listings, watches and alerts

get.summary: Price comparison across stores, with best deal and trust picks

post.summary: Refresh now. One refresh per item every 5 minutes.
post.description: Within the cooldown the response is 429 rate_limited with `retryAfterSeconds`. Another user's item is a 404, never a 429. Outside demo mode prices are left unchanged. A failed refresh gives the cooldown slot back.

200.description: Updated comparison and the number of alerts it created

get.summary: List all stores, A to Z

get.description: By default only live codes that are fresh (checked less than the user's freshnessHours ago) and not expired. `showDead=true` returns every code, with no freshness filter.

patch.summary: Mark a code live or dead. Records lastCheckedAt and lastCheckedById. Any signed-in user may do this.

get.summary: Get the user's settings (defaults if never saved)

patch.summary: Update settings. Any subset of fields.

get.summary: List the user's watches, newest first

post.summary: Watch an item in one size
post.description: The watch starts from the current price and stock, so an alert fires only on a later crossing. Limits: 10 watches per user, one per item and size. A duplicate is checked first, so re-submitting an existing watch gives `watch_exists`, not `watch_limit`. A 400 with code `no_listing` means no store has the size in stock.

size.description: Must be one of the item's sizes

targetPrice.description: USD, positive, at most 2 decimal places. Null or omitted means any drop

delete.summary: Delete a watch. No new alerts for it afterwards.

get.summary: List alerts grouped by item, newest group first. Returns the newest 200 alerts. unread and unreadCount are counted over all alerts.

patch.summary: Mark an alert read or unread

get.summary: Expire old codes, then refresh every item one by one. Called by Vercel Cron daily at 09:00 UTC.
get.description: No session. Needs `Authorization: Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}`. The 401 comes from a missing or wrong token, or an unset CRON_SECRET. Outside demo mode prices and stock stay as they are until a real data source lands, so the run only expires codes and re-checks watches.

codesExpired.description: Live codes past expiresAt, now marked dead

failed.description: Items whose refresh threw. They are skipped and logged.

post.summary: Demo only. Simulate price and stock moves on the user's items, then evaluate watches. If any item fails to refresh the response is 500 internal. Returns 404 unless DEMO_MODE=true, and 500 demo_disabled on a non-dev database.

itemId.description: Only this item. Omit for all of the user's items.

post.summary: Demo only. Reload seed data for the demo user and the seed codes. Returns 404 unless DEMO_MODE=true, and 500 demo_disabled on a non-dev database.

sessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
sessionCookie.description: Auth.js session cookie from Google sign-in (`__Secure-authjs.session-token` over HTTPS).

400.description: Invalid params, query or body. Code `bad_request`, or `no_listing` for a watch on a size nobody has in stock.

401.description: No session (or a bad cron token). Code `unauthorized`.

404.description: Not found, or not visible to this user. Demo routes return 404 when DEMO_MODE is off. Code `not_found`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next refresh is allowed

500.description: Unhandled error. Code `internal` (`demo_disabled` for demo routes on a non-dev database).

ItemFields.description: Item fields as returned by the API

typicalPrice.description: USD, positive, at most 2 decimal places
USD, positive, at most 2 decimal places

fictional.description: The store is a made-up demo store

cheapest.description: Cheapest in-stock listing for the saved size, with what a card needs to label it

value.description: Percent for pct, USD for flat

BestDeal.description: total = price - code.discount - cashback.amount. Cashback applies to the price after the code. Amounts are unrounded.

stores.description: Only stores that have a listing

bestDeals.description: One per listing, in listings order

bestDeal.description: Lowest total among listings in stock for the saved size

alreadyMet.description: True when the current cheapest in-stock price for the size is already at or below targetPrice. False for any drop. No alert fires for this, alerts fire only on a later crossing.

Alert.description: One schema per kind. `kind` decides the shape of `detail`.

watchId.description: Null after the watch is deleted. The alert stays.

size.description: The saved size the alert is about. It stays after the watch is deleted.
